text:
maria_sales: Hey team, customer (healthcare vendor) asked for a short POC that must use their HSM (BYO-HSM) + CMK rotation every 30 days. Need: timeline, pricing delta for BYO-HSM gateway, and what audit evidence we can supply.

maria_sales: Also they sent a 40‑page security questionnaire and pulled out questions about key custody, attestation, and rotation SLAs — any quick guidance before I reply?

tj_solutions: For a BYO-HSM POC we usually do a 2-week runway: day 0 kick, day 3 key handshake + connectivity, day 7 smoke tests, day 10 run sample traffic, day 14 wrap + handoff. We can compress if they accept limited traffic.

tj_solutions: Key steps: 1) PKCS#11 endpoint + cert exchange, 2) customer provides HSM network egress IPs and firewall rules, 3) set up gateway VM in their VPC (or our managed gateway if they prefer), 4) run attestation and key import tests.

maria_sales: Do we have a template SOW for the gateway + BYO-HSM integration? Customer wants a line item for HSM provisioning ops and a one-off handshake fee.

ben_infra: There is a short SOW template in /sales/templates but I'll attach the checklist here in the thread. Handshake is usually a one-time engineering fee (labor + travel if on‑prem). If we host the gateway in their VPC there's a small monthly managed gateway fee. Estimate: onboarding ops ~ 8–16 engineering hours, managed gateway $X00/mo — need to route to pricing for exact numbers.

ashley_security: On the questionnaire: we can confirm the following items now — we support envelope encryption + customer-managed CMKs and we can integrate with customer HSM via PKCS#11 or KMIP. We can provide: (a) attestation artifact from HSM vendor (if customer supplies), (b) our audit logs showing key usage (token-level, per-request), (c) SOC2 + ISO evidence we already have.

ashley_security: Regarding 30‑day rotation: our platform supports automated rotation, but forcing a full new CMK import every 30 days is heavy. We can support automated rewrapping/rotation of data encryption keys beneath a stable CMK (recommended). If they insist on CMK reimport every 30d we need an exception approval (risk increase + operational cadence).

maria_sales: They explicitly asked for "CMK rotate every 30 days with HSM-backed key generation and no cloud key copy" — sounds like they want full custody and periodic new CMK exports/imports. Is that feasible?

ashley_security: It's feasible but operationally costly: we need a documented runbook for key export/import (customer HSM → our gateway HSM) and an audit trail. Also confirm HSM model + attestation level (FIPS 140‑2/3 L3) — some HSMs don't allow key export. If their HSM disallows export we have to do key generation in their HSM and use remote signing/unwrap calls.

ben_infra: Practically: prefer in‑HSM generation + remote usage via PKCS#11 over exporting private key material. We'll set up the gateway to forward signing/unwrapping calls. Latency impact is measurable depending on RTT to customer HSM. We should load test during POC.

tj_solutions: For the security questionnaire reply I recommend these snippets: 1) Our system uses envelope encryption: data encrypted with DEKs, DEKs wrapped by customer CMK stored in HSM. 2) We can supply key usage logs (per-request, timestamped) and HSM attestation records. 3) Rotation: automated rewrap every N days; full CMK lifecycle by mutual agreement.

maria_sales: Is there a standard answer we can paste into the questionnaire for "key custody" and "rotation frequency" that doesn't commit us to 30d if we can't operationalize it?

ashley_security: Suggested wording: "Customer can supply and manage a CMK in their HSM. Redwood supports HSM-backed key operations via PKCS#11/KMIP and provides detailed key usage logs and attestation artifacts. Rotation policies (including frequency and method) are agreed in the SOW; we recommend rotating wrapped DEKs and rekeying CMKs according to risk and HSM capabilities." That keeps flexibility.

maria_sales: Perfect. Also they asked for proof of key zeroization after POC — can we provide an exportable audit or screenshot?

ashley_security: We can provide a signed confirmation of zeroization from the gateway (log + checksum) and include any HSM vendor attestation if available. If they require vendor-signed zeroization we need the vendor's tooling/access.

ben_infra: On infra: we'll need an IP allowlist, a small gateway instance, and a short-lived service account. estimate ~2–4 vCPU, 8GB for POC. I'll spin up a staging gateway once we have firewall rules.

maria_sales: Pricing question from customer: "Is BYO-HSM considered an enterprise add‑on and how much extra per month for managed gateway?"

tj_solutions: Short answer: BYO-HSM + managed gateway is an enterprise add-on. Ballpark: onboarding fee + $X00–$X50/mo for gateway depending on throughput and SLA. I'll follow up with exact banding from finance.

maria_sales: Can we offer a discounted POC price if they commit to Dedicated after? They asked for cost offset.

tj_solutions: We can offer a POC credit that applies to first month of Dedicated or Professional services, subject to sales approval. cc: finance in private thread for approval.

deploy-bot: Integration check ok — test PKCS#11 connectivity failed on first run due to firewall, succeeded after adding allowlist.

maria_sales: Nice — can you drop the sample PKCS#11 connection command we used so I can send to their infra?

tj_solutions: Sure: ``pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/your-pkcs11.so -l --pin 1234 -r > /tmp/objects.log`` and a minimal curl example for gateway health: ``curl -k https://gateway.company.internal/healthz``. Note: replace PIN and module path for their HSM.

maria_sales: Great. Last ask: timeline for security exception if they insist on CMK reimport every 30d?

ashley_security: We'll need a written risk exception request + runbook and a compensating controls checklist. Expect ~5 business days for review (depends on backlog). If they're flexible on rotation method we can avoid the exception.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll send the recommended questionnaire text, the sample SOW skeleton, and the rough pricing ranges. I'll flag the 30‑day reimport as an item that requires security exception and call out potential latency implications.

tj_solutions: Happy to join the call with the customer next week for HSM handshake. Ping me with preferred time slots.

maria_sales: Thx all. I'll post the finalized questionnaire answers and attach the template SOW here once approved by finance.
